changelog:
Initial public release of openapi-lark — OpenAPI to 飞书/Lark wiki automation.

- Syncs local or URL OpenAPI/Swagger specs to 飞书/Lark wiki & docx, supporting single, tree, and endpoint (per-interface docs) structures.
- Auto-splits documentation by tag and path-prefix, prioritizes Chinese titles, flattens allOf, generates field tables + JSON examples.
- Supports popular frameworks (chanfana, Hono, FastAPI, NestJS) with runtime `/openapi.json` endpoints; integrates with lark-cli.
- Includes features like multi-service support, zombie endpoint detection/pruning, hash caching, dry-run mode, and docToken misconfiguration warnings.
- Designed as a drop-in replacement for yapi OpenAPI pipelines.
